arrive.text: The ship of Theseus. Its wood is old and rotting, and it has to be repaired, a part at a time.

planks.text: New parts are laid out on the dock. Planks, deck boards, a mast and a sail.

first.text: The first new parts. Still the same ship, surely.

half.text: More than half of it is new now.

all.text: Not one original part is left. Is it still the same ship?

twist.text: Someone has kept every old part.

rebuilt.text: Two ships. Which one is the ship of Theseus?

new_end.text: You chose the ship that kept going. Not one part of it was there at the start. Is that enough?

old_end.text: You chose the original wood. Every part that ever sailed. But was it a ship, all that time in a pile?

mast.text: Even the mast. The old one lies on the dock.
